initialBuild.description:
Everything listed below is "in order" of priority

# DAMAGE PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:6]] -> [[talent:5]] -> 50 points [[talent:88]] -> [[talent:86]] -> [[talent:0]] -> [[talent:10]]
- [[talent:12]] (upgrade according to accuracy needed) -> [[talent:88]] -> [[talent:10]] -> [[talent:13]] 

## TAB 2

- 54 points [[talent:90]] = 54 points [[talent:91]] = 45 points [[talent:93]] = 1 point [[talent:94]] 
- [[talent:97]] -> [[talent:95]] -> [[talent:92]] -> [[talent:96]] = [[talent:98]] -> [[talent:93]] 
- Any additional points put in [[talent:94]] / [[talent:99]] 

## TAB 3

- [[talent:125]] (required 150% accuracy to gain dmg boost) -> [[talent:81]] -> [[talent:119]] 
- 1 point [[talent:120]] = 1 point [[talent:121]] = 1 point [[talent:122]] 
- [[talent:129]] (scales on bubble rank)

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:620]] -> [[talent:616]] (capped at 10% of highest level - ie level 100 means skill level 10)
- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:624]] = [[talent:627]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:638]] (More dungeon = more damage) -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
- Optional: [[talent:632]] , [[talent:629]] [[talent:640]]

-----

# SKILLING PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:85]] -> [[talent:89]] -> [[talent:10]] -> [[talent:0]] -> [[talent:13]] 
- Optional from here on out: [[talent:8]]

## TAB 2

- [[talent:100]] -> [[talent:101]] -> [[talent:103]] -> [[talent:102]] -> [[talent:92]] -> [[talent:98]] -> [[talent:99]] (If lots of golden peanuts and jam)
- 1 point [[talent:94]] 

## TAB 3

- [[talent:130]] -> [[talent:131]] -> [[talent:132]] -> [[talent:127]] -> [[talent:81]] 

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:625]] = [[talent:620]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:636]] -> [[talent:637]] -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
